items.title: Africa Is Not a Country, But the Travel Industry Keeps Treating It Like One
items.summary: A localized Ebola outbreak is leading to a continent-wide demand slump. The mechanism is well understood and almost nothing has been done about it.

items.title: Tripadvisor To Sell TheFork for $700 Million to Fuel Its Bet on Experiences
items.summary: The sale gives Tripadvisor the cash to chase the $1 trillion experiences market through Viator.

items.title: IHG Spent 8 Years Rebuilding Its Hotel Systems. Now It Says the Payoff Is Starting.
items.summary: IHG CEO Elie Maalouf is telling franchisees that eight years of tech investment has begun to expand their margins. It's an open question whether this early tech advantage will woo more hotel owners, boosting the growth rate of IHG's system.

items.title: World Cup Host Cities Are Spending Millions to Tell Wary Tourists: You’re Welcome Here
items.summary: The World Cup handed host cities a global stage. Marketing videos underscore how host cities are using it to reassure a world that has grown more hesitant to book U.S. travel.

items.title: Highgate Takes Over Lotte’s New York Palace — How it Feeds the Next Deal
items.summary: Buying and flipping broken hotels is lumpy and cyclical. Highgate's fees for third-party hotel management are a steady drip that keeps the lights on between the big, risky trades.

items.title: Navan Says Rivals’ Mergers Are Sending It More Clients
items.summary: Navan is winning large enterprise clients, picking them up when customers reevaluate their vendors in the face of protracted mergers.

items.title: Hotels Spent $100 Million Fighting OTAs. Did It Actually Work?
items.summary: If AI agents become the next distribution layer, does the decade-long battle between hotels and OTAs even matter anymore?

items.title: Kerten CEO Says First India Property by Year-End, Pipeline Likely to Exceed 1,000-Key Target: Exclusive
items.summary: India's hotel market doesn't need another global chain pretending to be local. Kerten Hospitality's entire bet is that developers have finally figured that out too.
